cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can an authorized security-testing scope specify?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Scope can define allowed IP addresses, applications, domains, techniques and testing periods. Some techniques may require additional explicit authorization.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Emergency awareness
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: In an emergency, personal safety comes first; follow local emergency guidance and seek trained help rather than taking unsafe risks.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why does cybersecurity awareness matter before anything goes wrong?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Cybersecurity awareness can help students recognize scams before becoming victims. Learning common warning signs supports safer decisions online.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Are cybercrime laws identical everywhere?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: No. Cybercrime laws differ between countries, so students should understand the laws that apply in their location.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: When money is tight, what usually deserves priority?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Chanakya's resource-priority ideas can be modernised into a simple budgeting principle: protect essential needs before optional spending.

meta.source_reference: Saving for adversity and prioritising what matters most

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which malware commonly blocks access to data and demands payment?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Ransomware commonly encrypts or otherwise blocks access to data and then demands payment.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why should you think carefully before posting something publicly?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: It may be hard to remove completely
Only you can ever see them

cards.explain: Photos, videos and personal information posted online can be difficult to remove completely, so consider carefully what you make public.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why is Trojan malware deceptive?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: A Trojan disguises malicious functionality as legitimate or useful software. It often depends on tricking a user into installing or executing it.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does a network switch typically use to forward Ethernet frames?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: A switch connects devices within a network and typically forwards Ethernet frames based on MAC addresses.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does decryption produce from ciphertext?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Decryption uses the appropriate key to convert ciphertext back into readable plaintext.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Effective cybersecurity depends on which combination?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Effective cybersecurity combines people, processes and technology rather than depending on a single security product.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Check that the devices you use have a screen lock enabled.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: An untrusted person asks for your login OTP. What should you do?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Never share an OTP or login verification code with an untrusted person. Verification codes help protect access to your account.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What typically helps a computer virus spread?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: A computer virus typically attaches to a legitimate file or program and often spreads when that infected file or program is executed.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why can some security questions be weak?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Questions based on publicly discoverable information can be weak recovery mechanisms because an attacker may be able to find the answers.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is malware seeking during privilege escalation?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Malware may attempt privilege escalation to obtain higher-level permissions on a compromised system.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: How should personal information be shared online?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Personal information should be shared carefully online because digital responsibility includes protecting information about yourself.

meta.source_reference: Personal information should be shared carefully online.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which protocol provides reliable, ordered delivery?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: TCP is connection-oriented and provides reliable, ordered delivery. UDP is connectionless and does not provide TCP's built-in reliability and ordering guarantees.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Is packet sniffing always malicious?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Packet sniffing means capturing and inspecting network packets. It can be used legitimately for troubleshooting or maliciously for surveillance.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why break goals into actions?
cards.subtitle: Connect goal setting to the way you think or act.

options.label: Yes — I want to explore this

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is one benefit of safety awareness?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Safety awareness can help prevent accidents by encouraging attention to possible risks.

meta.source_reference: Safety awareness can help prevent accidents.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which study pattern best matches Chanakya's daily-learning idea?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Chanakya Niti explicitly encourages learning something each day. Regular small sessions can make learning easier to sustain.

meta.source_reference: Verse urging daily learning even in small amounts

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can cooperation help a group achieve?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Cooperation helps people work together toward a common goal instead of working against one another.

meta.source_reference: Cooperation helps groups achieve common goals.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why does good communication matter?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Good communication can reduce misunderstandings by helping people understand one another more clearly.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What must a bug bounty researcher follow?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Bug bounty programs operate under defined rules. Researchers must follow the program's published scope and disclosure requirements.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What technology are passkeys based on?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Passkeys are a modern password alternative based on public-key cryptography, so a website does not need to store the user's reusable password.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does a cryptographic hash function produce?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: A readable copy of the input

cards.explain: A cryptographic hash function converts input data into a fixed-size digest. Secure hashes are designed so reversing the hash is computationally impractical.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: When should public access to cloud storage be enabled?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Cloud storage misconfiguration can expose sensitive information, so public access should be enabled only when it is intentionally required.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why is today's financial comfort not a guarantee about tomorrow?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Income, costs and circumstances can change. Chanakya warns that accumulated wealth can shrink, which supports planning rather than assuming stability.

meta.source_reference: Verse warning that accumulated wealth can dwindle during calamity

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why can dividing a network into separate sections improve security?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: It can limit unauthorized access and attack spread
It removes the need for security rules

cards.explain: Network segmentation divides a network into separate sections, which can help limit unauthorized access and the spread of attacks.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What makes spear phishing different from general phishing?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: It targets a particular person or organization

cards.explain: Spear phishing is customized for a particular person or organization rather than being a general phishing attempt.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why can pirated or cracked software be a cybersecurity risk?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Pirated or cracked software may contain malware. Avoiding unknown or suspicious downloads can reduce exposure to malicious software.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Say early when you cannot complete an agreed task.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to teamwork.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Pause before opening an unexpected attachment.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: How is a WAN different from a LAN?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: A LAN connects devices within a relatively small area, while a WAN connects networks across larger geographical areas.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Can a QR code lead to a phishing website?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: QR codes can direct users to phishing websites. Treat unexpected QR codes with the same caution you would use for suspicious links.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is cyberbullying?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Cyberbullying involves using digital communication to harass, threaten or humiliate someone. Harmful online behaviour can have real-world consequences.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Before opening an unexpected link or attachment, stop and check whether it looks suspicious.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What three protections can TLS help provide?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: TLS helps provide confidentiality, integrity and authentication for network communications.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which Wi-Fi protection is preferred when supported?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Wi-Fi networks should use modern security such as WPA2 or, preferably when supported, WPA3. WPA3 provides newer security mechanisms than WPA2.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Define one task you can finish in under 15 minutes.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to goal setting.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What best describes malware?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Malware is software intentionally designed to perform malicious activities. Categories include viruses, worms, Trojans, ransomware, spyware and rootkits.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why can temporary credentials reduce security risk?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: They limit stolen credentials' useful lifetime

cards.explain: Temporary credentials can reduce the useful lifetime of stolen authentication information compared with credentials that remain valid for a long time.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why should a financial plan include a buffer?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Because income and expenses can change unexpectedly. A buffer gives you more choices when something goes wrong.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why distinguish needs from wants?
cards.subtitle: Connect money basics to the way you think or act.

options.label: Yes — I want to explore this

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Who is responsible for security in the cloud?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Cloud security generally follows a shared responsibility model. Provider responsibilities vary by service, while customers remain responsible for many aspects of data, identities, permissions, configurations and applications.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Can poor key management weaken strong encryption?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Key management includes secure generation, storage, distribution, rotation, backup and destruction. Poor key management can undermine otherwise strong encryption algorithms.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why can a cyberattack target people instead of software?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Social engineering manipulates people into revealing information or performing unsafe actions. Attackers may rely on deception rather than attacking technology directly.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why does a consistent routine help?
cards.subtitle: Connect sleep to the way you think or act.

options.label: Yes — I want to explore this

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What helps a good habit become stronger?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Good habits become stronger through regular practice, so repetition matters when building useful routines.

meta.source_reference: Good habits become stronger through regular practice.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why should you be cautious with an unknown USB drive?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Unknown USB drives can contain malicious files or software, so connecting one to a device can create a security risk.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is a botnet?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: A botnet is a collection of compromised devices controlled by an attacker. Botnets can be used for DDoS attacks, spam distribution, and malware delivery.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Nutrition
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Balanced eating includes appropriate amounts of diverse foods, hydration and attention to individual needs.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: How can public personal information help a scammer?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Public information can sometimes help criminals create more convincing scams. Be thoughtful about how much personal information you share publicly online.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Teamwork
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Good teamwork combines shared goals, clear roles, reliable follow-through and constructive feedback.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why can saving money be useful?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Saving money can help you prepare for future needs instead of depending only on money available at that moment.

meta.source_reference: Saving money can help prepare for future needs.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does the OWASP Top 10 describe?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: OWASP is a nonprofit application-security organization, and its Top 10 describes important categories of web-application security risk.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which network usually covers a home, office or school?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: A Local Area Network, or LAN, connects devices within a relatively small area such as a home, office or school.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: How can heuristic analysis help find unfamiliar malware?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Heuristic analysis examines suspicious characteristics to help identify previously unknown or modified malware.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Pause before sharing content that makes you instantly angry or excited.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to media literacy.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is a firewall designed to control?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: A firewall controls network traffic according to configured security rules.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: End one request today with a clear next step.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to clear communication.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can a SIEM platform do with security logs?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: A SIEM platform can analyze cloud and other security logs to help detect suspicious patterns.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: How can teams handle blockers?
cards.subtitle: Connect teamwork to the way you think or act.

options.label: Yes — I want to explore this

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What makes money useful rather than merely possessed?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Resources create value when used thoughtfully—for needs, learning, resilience or helping others—not simply accumulated or wasted.

meta.source_reference: Verse linking wealth with proper spending

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why is hydration easy to overlook?
cards.subtitle: Connect nutrition to the way you think or act.

options.label: Yes — I want to explore this

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why use a different password for each important account?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: To limit damage from one breach

cards.explain: Reusing one password across websites can let a single credential breach put several accounts at risk.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What should come before protecting replaceable possessions in a serious emergency?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Personal safety. A modern, student-safe interpretation of Chanakya's priority hierarchy places human life and safety above replaceable property.

meta.source_reference: Priority hierarchy placing the self above possessions

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does DDoS protection primarily help maintain?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: DDoS protection helps maintain service availability when systems face large-scale traffic attacks.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: A budget helps you…
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: A simple budget separates income, needs, wants, saving and planned spending.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can reduce unnecessary impulse spending?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Chanakya's themes of moderation, saving and self-control translate well into pausing before optional purchases.

meta.source_reference: Saving, avoiding excess and balanced mind

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which security goal limits information to authorized people?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Confidentiality means information should be accessible only to authorized people or systems.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Time management
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Time management works better when priorities are converted into specific next actions and protected time.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can a VPN create across an untrusted network?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: A VPN can create an encrypted tunnel between endpoints across an untrusted network and is commonly used for secure remote access.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What should you do with a device's default password when possible?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Default passwords on routers, cameras and other devices should be changed when possible instead of being left as unnecessary default credentials.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why isn't SMS verification risk-free?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: SMS verification can improve security over password-only authentication, but SIM-swapping attacks can sometimes allow criminals to intercept authentication codes.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Where are public-facing services commonly isolated from internal systems?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: A DMZ is a network segment commonly used to isolate public-facing services from internal systems.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why should sensitive activities on public Wi-Fi be approached carefully?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Public Wi-Fi can create security risks, especially when sensitive activities are performed without appropriate protection.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: How can a password manager improve account security?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: A password manager can generate and store strong, unique passwords, reducing the need to memorize a different complex password for every account.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: During disagreement, what helps most?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: Describe the issue without personal attack

cards.explain: Constructive conflict resolution separates the problem from the person and looks for needs, facts and workable next steps.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is HTTPS?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: TLS protects many communications transmitted across networks. HTTPS is HTTP protected using TLS.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which backup approach can improve ransomware recovery?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: Saving everything only in one exposed location

cards.explain: Offline, isolated, or otherwise well-protected backups can improve recovery from ransomware and destructive malware incidents.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What should an ethical hacker prioritize while validating a vulnerability?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Ethical hackers should minimize potential damage while validating vulnerabilities and collect only the evidence needed to demonstrate security impact.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does multi-factor authentication add beyond a password?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Multi-factor authentication, or MFA, adds another security step beyond a password, providing an additional layer for account access.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which set lists four goals cryptography can help provide?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Cryptography can help provide confidentiality, integrity, authentication and non-repudiation.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why restate the other view?
cards.subtitle: Connect conflict resolution to the way you think or act.

options.label: Yes — I want to explore this

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: A practical activity habit is…
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: Move regularly in ways appropriate for you

cards.explain: Regular physical activity supports cardiovascular health, strength, mobility and mental wellbeing.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which factor matters when choosing where to study or live?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Chanakya discusses choosing places with livelihood, learning and essential support. A modern version includes safety, services, opportunity and community.

meta.source_reference: Verses about choosing a viable place to live

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What problem does CSPM help find?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Cloud Security Posture Management helps identify cloud configuration weaknesses and policy violations.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Tidy one small part of your study or living space.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

meta.source_reference: Keeping your surroundings clean promotes hygiene and organization.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Put one important task into a 20-minute calendar block.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to time management.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Review the privacy settings on one social-media account you use.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does encryption do to readable data?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Encryption transforms readable information, called plaintext, into an unreadable form called ciphertext.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: How can full-disk encryption help if a device is stolen?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Full-disk encryption can protect stored data on a lost or stolen device, particularly when the device is powered off or locked.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why can a rootkit be difficult to detect?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: A rootkit is designed to provide or conceal privileged, persistent access to a compromised system, which can make malicious activity difficult to detect.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why can good intentions still lead to illegal security testing?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Testing systems without authorization or outside the permitted scope can be illegal even when someone intends to improve security.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is spyware designed to do?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Spyware secretly monitors activity or collects information from a device, potentially including browsing information, credentials, or other sensitive data.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: For an important decision, whose advice is usually stronger?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Chanakya values learning and counsel. Today, the quality and relevance of expertise matter more than confidence or popularity.

meta.source_reference: Value of learning and wise counsel

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does the principle of least privilege recommend?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: Give only permissions needed for required tasks
Remove all access from every user

cards.explain: Least privilege means users and systems receive only the permissions necessary to perform their required tasks.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: How can a tiny input change affect a cryptographic hash?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Changing even a small part of the input should substantially change the resulting cryptographic hash. This property helps hashes verify data integrity.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does HTTPS help protect?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: HTTPS helps encrypt communication between your browser and a website, but it does not by itself prove that the website is trustworthy.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which security goal protects information from improper changes?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Integrity helps ensure information remains accurate and has not been improperly modified.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What best describes defense in depth?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Defense in depth combines controls such as firewalls, encryption, segmentation, authentication, monitoring, patching and secure configuration rather than relying on a single protection.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why is reusing one password across many accounts risky?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: One theft can expose several accounts

cards.explain: If a reused password is stolen, multiple accounts can become vulnerable. Strong, unique passwords reduce this risk.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why confirm understanding?
cards.subtitle: Connect clear communication to the way you think or act.

options.label: Yes — I want to explore this

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can network monitoring help defenders notice?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Network monitoring can help identify unusual traffic, failures, policy violations and potential attacks.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Check one network device you manage: is it still using a default password?
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What should you remember when using public Wi-Fi?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Use public Wi-Fi cautiously for sensitive activities. Internet safety includes thinking about the network you are using, not only the website or app.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why can a longer passphrase improve password security?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Longer passwords or passphrases are generally harder to guess, making length an important part of password security.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why can public Wi-Fi carry extra risk?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Public Wi-Fi can expose users to additional risks, especially when applications transmit sensitive information without appropriate encryption.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What prevents duplicated work?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Good teamwork combines shared goals, clear roles, reliable follow-through and constructive feedback.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can happen in a drive-by download?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Visiting a compromised or malicious website can cause unwanted software or exploit content to be downloaded or executed.
